sources.citation: Bracks, Christoph. 2023. A documentation of Gorap / Dokumentasi Bahasa Gorap. Endangered Languages Archive (ELAR) deposit dk0710, University of Frankfurt
sources.note: Landing page lists stimulus-based recordings (Pear Film, Man and Tree), folktales, transcriptions and translations; no grammar sketch, phonology notes or publications listed. Item-level access requires ELAR registration.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x languoid page gora1261 and reference records 706188 (Taha, Amris, Febriningsih & Fokaaya 2014, Kamus dwibahasa Indonesia-Gorap, Ternate: Kantor Bahasa Provinsi Maluku Utara, xiv+66, doctype wordlist) and 569683 (Campbell et al. 2022 ElCat)
sources.note: Bibliographic only. Glottolog lists no grammar, phonology or sketch for Gorap; the most descriptive item is the 2014 bilingual dictionary (wordlist doctype).

sources.citation: Badan Pengembangan dan Pembinaan Bahasa, Peta Bahasa: 'Bahasa Gorap, Provinsi Maluku Utara' (petabahasa.kemdikbud.go.id, idb=779; the Internet Archive 2024-01-09)
sources.note: Nothing; location, creole/pidgin origin and dialectometry (81-100% difference from Buli, Ibu, Tobelo, Ternate Malay) only.

sources.citation: Sa'diyah, Umiatun & Gede Sidi Artajaya. 2024. Kekerabatan Bahasa Jawa, Bahasa Gorap, dan Bahasa Tetun: Kajian Linguistik Historis Komparatif. Stilistika 13(1): 108-119.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request); only the abstract or a snippet was reachable when a reader tried
sources.note: Lexicostatistic (comparative-historical) study by the author of the 2020 phonology report; may summarise Gorap phonology or cite the report's findings. The OJS galley currently serves an empty file.

sources.citation: Bracks, Christoph. 2023-. A documentation of Gorap / Dokumentasi Bahasa Gorap. ELAR deposit dk0710 (University of Frankfurt); any resulting sketch grammar or prosody paper.
sources.note: Bracks is a prosody specialist (Papuan Malay, Totoli intonation) running the only modern documentation project on Gorap; a phonology/prosody sketch from this project would supersede everything else. Deposit items need ELAR login; no publication indexed yet.

sources.citation: Taha, Mujahid & Fida Febriningsih. 2022. "Bahasa Gorap: Pemersatu Etnik di Teluk Kao." Sinar Bahtera: Prosiding Seminar Internasional Bahasa dan Sastra Daerah I, pp. 191-198. Balai Bahasa Provinsi Kalimantan Tengah. DOI 10.51817/sb.vi.99
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Sociolinguistic paper with a 200-item Swadesh comparison (Gorap vs Ternate Malay, Bugis, Cia-cia, Pulo); no phonology section. It only reports (p. 192) that Kantor Bahasa Provinsi Maluku Utara produced an unpublished 2020 'Fonologi Bahasa Gorap' report analysing vowels and consonants (Sa'diyah 2020) and a 2014 Indonesian-Gorap dictionary (Taha et al. 2014). This PDF is what English Wikipedia mislabels as 'Sa'diyah 2020 Laporan Fonologi Bahasa Gorap'.
